outcome: Concentrations of acesulfame in maternal plasma, fetal plasma, and amniotic fluid
Concentrations of cyclamate in maternal plasma, fetal plasma, and amniotic fluid
Concentrations of saccharin in maternal plasma, fetal plasma, and amniotic fluid
Concentrations of sucralose in maternal plasma, fetal plasma, and amniotic fluid
cohort: The study included 19 pregnant women who received an oral dose of artificial sweeteners immediately before a planned caesarean section, and 9 pregnant women as controls who refrained from intake.
finding: All four investigated artificial sweeteners (acesulfame, cyclamate, saccharin, and sucralose) crossed the placenta and were present in the fetal circulation and amniotic fluid, showing a linear relationship between maternal and fetal plasma concentrations.
cross-section timing: Immediately before and during a planned caesarean section
